ThingDef.label: button mushroom
ThingDef.description: Edible button mushrooms. Can be cooked in ordinary meals or eaten raw. Counts as fungus. Eating it raw or in a meal grants +3 mood for 6 hours. Only the strongest mushroom bonus applies; eating a weaker mushroom does not extend it. Normal food and ideology effects still apply.
